question: Who among the following threw 19.59 m to bag Silver medal in Shot Put at Asian U-18 Athletics Championship in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nishchay**__.

__
 
• **Nishchay** threw a remarkable distance of **19.59 m** in the **Shot Put event** at the **Asian U-18 Athletics Championship** held in **April 2025**.
 
• His performance earned him the prestigious **Silver Medal**, showcasing his exceptional skill and dedication in the sport.
 
• The **Asian U-18 Athletics Championship** is a significant event that features young athletes from across Asia competing in various athletic disciplines.
 
• Shot Put is a track and field event where participants attempt to throw a heavy spherical object known as the "shot" as far as possible.
 
• Other notable participants in the competition included **Anuragh G**, **VS Anupriya**, and **Vidhi**, but Nishchay’s record-breaking throw stood out as the second-best performance.

• **Asian U-18 Athletics Championship:**

 
 
• The championship is an international event organized by the **Asian Athletics Association**, focusing on athletes under the age of 18.
 
• It provides a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and compete at a continental level.
 
• The competition includes a variety of track and field events such as **running, jumping, and throwing** disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Shot Put Event:**
 
 
• Shot Put is a field event in athletics where athletes throw a heavy spherical object called the "shot."
 
• The objective is to throw the shot as far as possible within the designated sector.
 
• It requires a combination of **strength, technique, and precision**, making it one of the most challenging throwing events.
